text:
Priya (Sales): quick one 12 Zephyr Labs wants extra trial credits. they ran into SSO gating in their prod-ish env and need 75k more tokens to finish a demo. they said they'll sign a 3mo $1500/mo commit if we extend. any quick precedent? @DealDesk Bot
Diego (Solutions): SE: they need SAML assertion flow verified. i can do a short SSO PoC on our sandbox but itll take ~24h. embeddings use looks light (5k vectors).
Anya (Security): need the security questionnaire answers before prefs. specifically: are logs scrubbed? where are dev buckets located? also want to confirm whether redirect URIs contain customer data.
Priya (Sales): pasted their SQ answer snippet: `logs redacted; retention 14d; dev buckets in us-west-2; no raw customer uploads`. link to doc: https://internal-upload/zephyr-sq
Anya (Security): ok i'll review the doc. fast path if logs are actually redacted (show a sample masked line).
DealDesk Bot: Reminder: automatic startup credits cap = $5k. Any exception >$5k needs manager approval + simple commit (min $1k/mo) or signed SOW. See /policies/startup-credits
Priya (Sales): 75k tokens ~ $975 at published hosted rates. still under $5k but above our automated send threshold for some regions. theyre asking for token bump + 30d trial extension. can we do an admin promo now?
Finance Bot: finance rule: promo credits require an expiring credit note (90d) and ledger entry. unconditional credits >=$500 need ops manager. Conditional grants allowed pending signed MSA/PO.
Elena (CS): customer success suggests: give a conditional credit tied to PoC addendum + limit embeddings to 5k vectors. we'll help run the SSO PoC.
Diego (Solutions): proposed: 1) issue conditional promo $1,000 (approx 75k tokens) expiring 90d; 2) require signed PoC addendum within 10 days committing to discuss conversion; 3) SE delivers SSO PoC in 24h; 4) enforce embeddings cap 5k.
Priya (Sales): can @DealDesk Bot route for manager pre-approval so i can tell the buyer yes? i'll attach the PoC addendum and sample log mask.
DealDesk Bot: Escalation created: DD-2026-512. Pre-approve: conditional $1,000 promo pending security review and signed PoC addendum. Manager review required (ops_mgr@redwood). ETA 24-36h.
Anya (Security): i reviewed sample masked log. good. ill sign off once we have confirmation that S3 buckets are read-only for engineering.
Priya (Sales): uploaded screenshot: https://internal-upload/s3-acl-zephyr.png 
DealDesk Bot: Manager approved conditional $1,000 token promo. Conditions: PoC addendum signed within 10 days; security confirmation of S3 ACLs; embeddings limited to 5k. Credit expires 90d if conditions unmet. Ticket: DD-2026-512 -> approved_by: ops_mgr
Priya (Sales): awesome, sending to customer now. will update thread when they sign. thanks all :raised_hands:
Elena (CS): i'll queue onboarding steps and calendar SSO PoC session.
